articles.summary: Camillo Martino to Continue as Chairman of the Board SEOUL, South Korea–(BUSINESS WIRE)–Magnachip Semiconductor Corporation (NYSE: MX, “Magnachip”) announced the appointment of Chae Lee as Chief Executive Officer, effective July 1, 2026.
